reviews.comment: Dr. Zhang provided many opportunities for extra credit which is why I ended the class with 104. The exams are similar to the practice exams she provides and are overall not too difficult. There is suggested reading but you can get by just reading the slides to post. There is no homework so go to class and take notes to learn the material.

This class started off very difficult with only 5 quizzes (6 questions), 3 tests and a project as the entire grade. As the semester went along, the professor provided 3 bonus points opportunities to help raise grades. The last two tests also had curves. It is best to review the lectures after class and understand concepts instead of memorizing.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I disagree with most of the comments. She is easily understandable. No homework. Very easy exams. Difficult quizzes but balanced by a lot of extra credit. Easy & quick group project. If you show up to each lecture, take notes, and study before tests and quizzes (aka the bare minimum) you'll do just fine. One of the easiest classes I've ever taken.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: While I have seen other ratings of this professor I believe that they are way too harsh. This professor puts a lot of time and effort into this class and to do well in it you must also do so. While I didn't expect this geography class to be mostly about weather I have taken it in stride and have tried my best. also btw always attend class!

English is not her first language, which makes lectures a little hard to understand. She made multiple mistakes while writing the exam and we tried to bring it up to her so that it didn't happen again, she got mad and didn't take the blame. She then was rude and difficult the rest of the semester. DO NOT TAKE HER, FIND ANYONE ELSE
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: It is sometimes difficult to understand what she is saying, the the semester I had her she was always gone on some research trip so it seems like class was online half the time. The exams aren't too bad if you do the sample exams. Sometimes there are in class quizzes, but she usually tells you when they are so there are no surprises.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The professor has never given me any issues. However, her accent is extremely thick and makes understanding her lectures really difficult. Not only is her accent thick but she talks fast and her presentations are vague. Practice exams not like the test. Lots of extra credit is offered though (only because students were failing).

She is overall very harsh and not helpful/understanding at all. The only reason why she provided a lot of extra credit at the end of the semester was b/c most people were failing and she received multiple complaints. She does not explain material in lectures too well for us to understand, and has a heavy accent so it may be hard to understand her.

the class isn't too hard if you listen, but she has a very strong accent so it can be hard to pay attention. she was HORRIBLE at first, but got so many complaints that she now offers lots of extra credit and made the exams easier. still wouldn't take her again. she is rude and not helpful if you don't understand something

The tests and quizzes are difficult, but there are a lot of extra credit opportunities. Attendance is not required, but there are occasional attendance sheets that can give you bonus points. The group project is easy and you have a lot of time to do it. Not the easiest class, but I would take it again.

Take this class for a good GPA boost. Attendance isn't necessary, but you get extra credit. She gave 15 extra credit points in total, so VERY easy A. Lectures are a bit hard to follow, but exams and quizzes are easy if you take notes.
Not sympathetic. Practice Exams are nothing like the actual exam. Studied hard for exams, never got above a 70 on any. Don't take this class.

I failed my first exam even though I studied for hours. I was some how able to bounce back a little, but it was the biggest stress of my life. Almost dropped the class. Hard to understand. Extremely boring. Wasn't in class for like three weeks. Wasn't even a major specific class and yet took over my whole semester. Avoid if possible, not worth it.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Zhang's class is great. There is no homework, lots of extra credit, 3 exams, some quizzes, and an easy project. Sit towards the front of the class since it is a big lecture hall and she doesn't use a speaker. People say her accent is indecipherable but it really isn't bad. If you attend class and ask for help you can get an A.

This is probably the worst teacher I have ever had Not only is she not qualified to teach this class, but she speaks the worst English I have ever heard Sit in the back of the class or the front and you will not be able to understand a word she says I just q dropped after talking to department heads begging for a free q drop because she was so bad

Dr. Zhang is a not-so-great teacher who happens to be completely inept at speaking English. Her lectures are confusing, lack any actual content, and are very redundant. She blames every issue that students bring up on everyone but herself. The content itself isn't bad but it is very hard when you have this prof. 

Steer clear of her.
Really hard to understand her accent, super boring class, tough grader, hard quizzes, barely any extra credit. DO NOT TAKE HER
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things
